candidates.phrase: who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible
candidates.rationale: Directly confesses God as Sovereign over all things, asserting supreme dominion of the one God.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe in the one true, holy and living God, Eternal Spirit, who is Creator, Sovereign and Preserver of all things visible and invisible. He is infinite in power, wisdom, justice, goodness and love, and rules with gracious regard for the well-being and salvation of men, to the glory of his name. We believe the one God reveals himself as the Trinity: Father, Son and Holy Spirit, distinct but inseparable, eternally one in essence and power.

candidates.phrase: civil government derives its just powers from the sovereign God
candidates.rationale: Asserts God as sovereign source of governmental power, affirming God's supreme dominion.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe civil government derives its just powers from the sovereign God. As Christians we recognize the governments under whose protection we reside and believe such governments should be based on, and be responsible for, the recognition of human rights under God. We believe war and bloodshed are contrary to the gospel and spirit of Christ. We believe it is the duty of Christian citizens to give moral strength and purpose to their respective governments through sober, righteous and godly living.

candidates.locator: Article XV — The Christian and Property
candidates.phrase: used responsibly for human good under the sovereignty of God
candidates.rationale: Affirms God's sovereignty as the governing authority over all property and human good.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe God is the owner of all things and that the individual holding of property is lawful and is a sacred trust under God. Private property is to be used for the manifestation of Christian love and liberality, and to support the Church's mission in the world. All forms of property, whether private, corporate or public, are to be held in solemn trust and used responsibly for human good under the sovereignty of God.

candidates.phrase: acknowledge God as our only Supreme Ruler
candidates.rationale: Directly names God as the sole Supreme Ruler, asserting supreme dominion over all persons.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe that the two great commandments which require us to love the Lord our God with all the heart, and our neighbors as ourselves, summarize the divine law as it is revealed in the Scriptures. They are the perfect measure and norm of human duty, both for the ordering and directing of families and nations, and all other social bodies, and for individual acts, by which we are required to acknowledge God as our only Supreme Ruler, and all persons as created by Him, equal in all natural rights. Therefore all persons should so order all their individual, social and political acts as to give to God entire and absolute obedience, and to assure to all the enjoyment of every natural right, as well as to promote the fulfillment of each in the possession and exercise of such rights.

candidates.phrase: the Creator and Preserver of all things
candidates.rationale: Describes God's universal creative and sustaining dominion over all things, a narrower expression of sovereignty.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe in the one living and true God, both holy and loving, eternal, unlimited in power, wisdom and goodness, the Creator and Preserver of all things. Within this unity there are three persons of one essential nature, power and eternity — the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

candidates.locator: Article 21. The Judgment of All Persons, ¶248
candidates.phrase: reveal God as the Judge of all
candidates.rationale: Asserts God's supreme authority to judge all persons, implying sovereign dominion in the judicial sense.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe that the Scriptures reveal God as the Judge of all and the acts of His judgment are based on His omniscience and eternal justice. His administration of judgment will culminate in the final meeting of all persons before His throne of great majesty and power, where records will be examined and final rewards and punishments will be administered.
